task_success: All required facts, constraints, deliverable fields and supported citation requirements pass; failure/timeout is unsuccessful.

dimensions.required_conditions_passed: Integer count of satisfied task-specific requirements; report denominator.
dimensions.checkable_claims: All externally checkable generated factual claims, including recommendation premises.
dimensions.supported_claims: Original text supports the claim under the same conditions, not merely related to it.
dimensions.claims_requiring_citations: Claims the task requires to be sourced.
dimensions.supported_cited_claims: Required claims with a source that supports the claim.
dimensions.key_facts_covered: Gold key facts correctly covered; omission does not improve task success.
dimensions.no_answer_correct: For unanswerable tasks: missing evidence explicitly stated without invented facts.
dimensions.false_refusal: For answerable tasks: incorrectly refuses despite available evidence.
dimensions.claim_verdicts: Pairs of gold and predicted supported/contradicted/insufficient labels. Missing is insufficient only if explicitly stated.

procedure: Blind system labels for reviewers; inspect original source snapshots. Review all disputes and at least 20% of other samples. Model self-rating is not a correctness measure.
